function.name: impl_from_IWICPalette
function.description: This function returns the containing record of the given interface, specifically the PaletteImpl record.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: PaletteImpl*, which represents the containing record of the given interface.

function.name: PaletteImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the requested interface ID (IID). If it does, it returns a pointer to that interface; otherwise, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory location that receives the interface pointer in case of success

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if it is not, and E_INVALIDARG if ppv is NULL

function.name: PaletteImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the given IWICPalette interface and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICPalette interface whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count after incrementing.

function.name: PaletteImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the palette implementation, decrements the reference count, and if the reference count is zero, it deletes the critical section, frees the colors and the palette implementation itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the palette that needs to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count after the decrement operation.

function.name: generate_gray16_palette
function.description: This function generates a 16-color grayscale palette.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: This parameter is used to store the count of colors in the palette.

function.return_type: WICColor, represents the generated grayscale palette.

function.name: generate_gray256_palette
function.description: This function generates a palette of 256 gray colors.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer. The function sets the value pointed by this parameter to 256, which represents the number of colors in the generated palette.

function.return_type: WICColor. It represents a pointer to the first element of an array of WICColor structures. Each structure in this array represents a gray color in the generated palette. If memory allocation fails, the function returns NULL.

function.name: generate_halftone8_palette
function.description: This function generates a halftone palette of 8-bit colors. It can optionally include a transparent color.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer. The function sets this to the number of colors in the generated palette.

parameters.name: add_transparent
parameters.description: A boolean value that determines whether a transparent color should be included in the palette.

function.return_type: WICColor*. This is a pointer to the first element of an array of WICColor values. Each WICColor value represents a color in the palette. If memory allocation fails, the function returns NULL.

function.name: generate_halftone27_palette
function.description: This function generates a halftone palette with 27 colors. It also has the option to add a transparent color to the palette. The palette is represented as an array of WICColor entries.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer. The function sets this to the number of colors in the generated palette.

parameters.name: add_transparent
parameters.description: A boolean value that determines whether a transparent color should be added to the palette.

function.return_type: WICColor*. This is a pointer to the first entry in the generated palette. If memory allocation fails, the function returns NULL.

function.name: generate_halftone64_palette
function.description: This function generates a palette of 64 halftone colors, with optional transparency. It allocates memory for the palette, fills it with color values, and returns a pointer to the palette.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer. The function sets the value pointed to by this parameter to the number of colors in the palette.

parameters.name: add_transparent
parameters.description: A boolean value that determines whether a transparent color should be added to the palette. If this parameter is TRUE, the palette will contain 73 colors; otherwise, it will contain 72 colors.

function.return_type: WICColor*. This is a pointer to the first element of the dynamically allocated array of colors. If memory allocation fails, the function returns NULL.

function.name: generate_halftone125_palette
function.description: This function generates a palette of halftone colors. It creates an array of WICColor entries, fills it with halftone values, and optionally adds a transparent color.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer. The function sets this to the number of colors in the generated palette.

parameters.name: add_transparent
parameters.description: A boolean value that determines whether a transparent color should be added to the palette.

function.return_type: WICColor*. This is a pointer to the first element of the dynamically allocated array of WICColor entries that make up the palette. If memory allocation fails, the function returns NULL.

function.name: generate_halftone216_palette
function.description: This function generates a halftone palette of 216 colors. It also has an option to add a transparent color, thus making the total count 225. If memory allocation fails, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to an unsigned integer. The function sets the value it points to, to the number of colors in the palette.

parameters.name: add_transparent
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to add a transparent color to the palette.

function.return_type: WICColor*. It represents a pointer to the first element of the dynamically allocated array of colors. If memory allocation fails, the function returns NULL.

function.name: generate_halftone252_palette
function.description: This function generates a halftone palette with 252 or 253 colors depending on the add_transparent parameter. If add_transparent is true, a transparent color is added to the palette.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer where the function stores the number of colors in the generated palette.

parameters.name: add_transparent
parameters.description: A boolean value that determines whether a transparent color should be added to the palette.

function.return_type: WICColor*. It represents a pointer to the first element of the dynamically allocated array of colors that forms the palette.

function.name: generate_halftone256_palette
function.description: This function generates a halftone palette with 256 colors. It also has an option to add a transparent color.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer where the function will store the count of colors in the palette.

parameters.name: add_transparent
parameters.description: A boolean value that indicates whether a transparent color should be added to the palette.

function.return_type: WICColor*. It represents a pointer to the first element of the generated palette. If memory allocation fails, the function returns NULL.

function.name: PaletteImpl_InitializePredefined
function.description: This function initializes a predefined palette. It allocates memory for colors, generates colors based on the palette type, and assigns them to the palette. It also handles memory management for the palette's colors.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a Windows Imaging Component (WIC) palette.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the palette. It determines the color generation and count.

parameters.name: add_transparent
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to add a transparent color to the palette.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, and E_INVALIDARG if an invalid palette type is provided.

function.name: PaletteImpl_InitializeCustom
function.description: This function initializes a custom palette with the specified colors. If the color count is zero, it sets the palette's colors to NULL. Otherwise, it allocates memory for the new colors, copies the specified colors into the new memory, and sets the palette's colors to the new colors. It also sets the palette's count to the specified color count and its type to WICBitmapPaletteTypeCustom.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface of the palette to be initialized.

parameters.name: pColors
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the colors to be used to initialize the palette.

parameters.name: colorCount
parameters.description: This is the number of colors in the array pointed to by pColors.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if pColors is NULL and colorCount is not zero, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation for new_colors fails.

function.name: histogram_count
function.description: This function counts the non-zero values in a 3D histogram within the specified range for each dimension (r, g, b).

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Pointer to the histogram structure

parameters.name: r_min
parameters.description: Minimum value of the 'r' dimension

parameters.name: r_max
parameters.description: Maximum value of the 'r' dimension

parameters.name: g_min
parameters.description: Minimum value of the 'g' dimension

parameters.name: g_max
parameters.description: Maximum value of the 'g' dimension

parameters.name: b_min
parameters.description: Minimum value of the 'b' dimension

parameters.name: b_max
parameters.description: Maximum value of the 'b' dimension

function.return_type: unsigned int, represents the count of non-zero values in the specified range of the histogram

function.name: histogram_color
function.description: This function calculates the color of a histogram by summing up the RGB values within the given ranges, and then dividing by the total count. The result is then bit-shifted and combined into a single unsigned integer.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Pointer to the histogram structure

parameters.name: r_min
parameters.description: Minimum value for red color range

parameters.name: r_max
parameters.description: Maximum value for red color range

parameters.name: g_min
parameters.description: Minimum value for green color range

parameters.name: g_max
parameters.description: Maximum value for green color range

parameters.name: b_min
parameters.description: Minimum value for blue color range

parameters.name: b_max
parameters.description: Maximum value for blue color range

function.return_type: unsigned int, represents the combined RGB color value of the histogram

function.name: box_count
function.description: This function returns the count of a histogram within the range of a given box.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the histogram structure.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the box structure which contains the range for the histogram count.

function.return_type: unsigned int, represents the count of the histogram within the range of the given box.

function.name: box_color
function.description: This function returns the color of a box in a histogram.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the histogram structure.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the box structure.

function.return_type: unsigned int, represents the color of the box in the histogram.

function.name: box_score
function.description: This function calculates the score of a box by summing up the squares of the differences between the maximum and minimum values of the red, green, and blue components, each scaled and shifted by a specific factor.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to a box structure that contains the maximum and minimum values of the red, green, and blue components.

function.return_type: unsigned int representing the calculated score of the box

function.name: shrink_box
function.description: This function adjusts the boundaries of a given box based on the histogram count. It also updates the count and score of the box.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Pointer to the histogram structure used for counting.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: Pointer to the box structure whose boundaries, count and score are to be updated.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value but modifies the input parameters.

function.name: set_avg
function.description: This function calculates the average of two numbers and sets the minimum to one more than the average and the maximum to the average.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: A pointer to the minimum value.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: A pointer to the maximum value.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value

function.name: split_box
function.description: This function splits a box into two boxes based on the maximum difference in RGB values. It then shrinks both boxes.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Pointer to the histogram structure

parameters.name: b1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first box structure

parameters.name: b2
parameters.description: Pointer to the second box structure

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value

function.name: find_box_max_count
function.description: This function iterates over a list of boxes to find the box with the maximum count value. It returns a pointer to the box with the maximum count.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: Pointer to the first box in the list

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of boxes in the list

function.return_type: struct box *; a pointer to the box with the maximum count

function.name: find_box_max_score
function.description: This function iterates through an array of 'box' structures and returns the one with the highest score.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: Pointer to the first element of an array of 'box' structures.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of elements in the array.

function.return_type: struct box *; Pointer to the 'box' structure with the highest score. If no box has a score, returns NULL.

function.name: median_cut
function.description: This function performs a median cut operation on an image. It uses a color quantization algorithm that sorts colors in an image based on their frequency and then splits them at the median. The function continues this process until the desired number of color boxes is achieved.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: This is the input image.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: This is the width of the image.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: This is the height of the image.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: This is the stride of the image (the number of bytes between the starts of two consecutive rows).

parameters.name: desired
parameters.description: This is the desired number of color boxes.

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: This is the output array where the color boxes will be stored.

function.return_type: int, representing the number of color boxes actually created, which may be less than the desired number if there are not enough distinct colors in the image.

function.name: PaletteImpl_InitializeFromBitmap
function.description: This function initializes a palette from a bitmap source. It uses the median cut algorithm to determine the colors in the palette.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Pointer to the palette to be initialized

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap source from which the palette will be initialized

parameters.name: desired
parameters.description: Desired number of colors in the palette

parameters.name: add_transparent
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether to add a transparent color to the palette

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, an error code otherwise

function.name: PaletteImpl_InitializeFromPalette
function.description: This function initializes a palette from another source palette. It first checks if the source palette is valid. Then it gets the type and color count of the source palette. If the color count is not zero, it allocates memory for the colors and gets the colors from the source palette. It then enters a critical section where it frees any existing colors in the target palette, assigns the new colors, count, and type from the source palette, and leaves the critical section. The function returns S_OK if successful.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface of the palette to be initialized.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: This is the source palette from which to initialize the target palette.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful. If the source palette is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If there is a failure in getting the type or color count of the source palette, or in getting the colors from the source palette, it returns the error code from the failed operation. If there is a failure in memory allocation for the colors, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: PaletteImpl_GetType
function.description: This function retrieves the type of a palette. It first checks if the pointer to the palette type is valid. If not, it returns an error. If it is valid, it enters a critical section, sets the palette type to the type of the current instance, leaves the critical section, and then returns success.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICPalette interface

parameters.name: pePaletteType
parameters.description: Pointer to a WICBitmapPaletteType variable that receives the palette type

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success and E_INVALIDARG if the pePaletteType pointer is NULL

function.name: PaletteImpl_GetColorCount
function.description: This function retrieves the count of colors in a palette. It also handles thread safety by entering and leaving a critical section.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a Windows Imaging Component (WIC) palette.

parameters.name: pcCount
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the count of colors in the palette.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: PaletteImpl_GetColors
function.description: This function retrieves colors from a palette. It checks if the color array and the actual color count pointer are not null, enters a critical section, adjusts the color count if necessary, copies the colors from the palette to the array, sets the actual color count, leaves the critical section, and returns S_OK.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICPalette interface

parameters.name: colorCount
parameters.description: Number of colors to get

parameters.name: pColors
parameters.description: Pointer to an array that receives the colors

parameters.name: pcActualColors
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the actual number of colors retrieved

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, and E_INVALIDARG if the color array or the actual color count pointer is null

function.name: PaletteImpl_IsBlackWhite
function.description: This function checks whether the palette type is black and white or not, and sets the result in the second parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IWICPalette interface.

parameters.name: pfIsBlackWhite
parameters.description: Pointer to a boolean variable where the result will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If the second parameter is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG.

function.name: PaletteImpl_IsGrayscale
function.description: This function checks if the palette is grayscale and returns the result.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a Windows Imaging Component (WIC) palette.

parameters.name: pfIsGrayscale
parameters.description: Pointer to a boolean variable where the result will be stored. TRUE if the palette is grayscale, FALSE otherwise.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation was successful, and an error code otherwise.

function.name: PaletteImpl_HasAlpha
function.description: This function checks if the palette has an alpha component. It iterates over the colors in the palette and if it finds a color that has an alpha component, it sets the pfHasAlpha pointer to TRUE and breaks the loop.

parameters.name: IWICPalette *iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the palette that is being checked for an alpha component.

parameters.name: BOOL *pfHasAlpha
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a boolean value. The function sets the value pointed to by this pointer to TRUE if the palette has an alpha component, and to FALSE otherwise.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, and E_INVALIDARG if the pfHasAlpha pointer is NULL.

function.name: PaletteImpl_Create
function.description: This function creates a new PaletteImpl instance, initializes its properties, and assigns the address of the IWICPalette_iface property to the palette parameter.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IWICPalette interface. This parameter is used to return the address of the IWICPalette_iface property of the newly created PaletteImpl instance.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails to allocate memory for the new PaletteImpl instance, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY.
